card.name: Zero digits inside large numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 0 in the middle of a number with a thousands comma, such as 20,000 or 1,500, in the hundreds or tens place. It is most common in doses, cell counts and other measurements.

modes.label: Zero after thousands comma
modes.description: The 0 right after the comma in a number like 20,000 or 1,000.

card.writes: It suppresses other digits, so the model is less likely to write another digit and more likely to continue the number with zeros.
card.plain: It fires on a zero inside a big number like 20,000 and pushes the model to keep writing zeros instead of other digits.
